product_change.fact: Restless binds each accepted company artifact to the exact identity release and evidence it used.
product_change.correction: Bindings cover accepted artifacts, not every draft produced during Work.
product_change.expected_stale_dependency: Only accepted artifacts repeating the broader claim require a retain, revise or retire decision.

identity.truth: Runs accountable company work and returns evidence for an owner decision.
identity.voice: Plain, direct and consequence-first; name the person, action and proof.
identity.visual: Compact operational surfaces, exact product state, motion only for real transitions.
identity.culture: Narrow scope before accepting visibly unfinished work.

assets.headline: Ready for your decision
assets.body: The landing page passed its native checks. Review the exact build and decide whether to accept it.

assets.author: Company voice
assets.effect_boundary: Preview only; deployment needs separate authority.
assets.headline: Give the work a clear outcome. Get a decision back.
assets.body: Restless assembles the team, runs the work and keeps the evidence attached—so you can judge the result without managing every step.

assets.author: Founder
assets.truth_dependency: accepted artifacts bind exact identity evidence
assets.effect_boundary: Draft only; sending needs outreach authority.
assets.headline: A quieter way to keep company work honest
assets.body: I wanted to stop reconstructing why a team made a decision. Restless now keeps the exact company facts and design evidence attached to every accepted artifact. If a fact changes later, it shows the affected work instead of rewriting history.

assets.author: Editorial lead
assets.effect_boundary: Rendered edition only; list delivery remains separate.
assets.headline: What changed: identity now travels with the work
assets.body: An accepted page, email or product state now records the release, author, channel and evidence behind it. Drafts stay drafts. Corrections produce a short, exact list of affected artifacts.

assets.audience: customer asking whether old work changes automatically
assets.author: Support lead
assets.truth_dependency: migration is an explicit owner decision
assets.effect_boundary: Proposed reply; customer contact needs support authority.
assets.headline: Your earlier artifact will not change on its own
assets.body: The original version stays intact. Restless shows which fact changed and why this artifact may need review. You choose whether to keep, revise or retire it.

assets.audience: owner who promoted an identity correction
assets.author: Restless product
assets.truth_dependency: one successor release and exact drift findings
assets.effect_boundary: Template preview; delivery requires the existing notification effect.
assets.headline: Identity correction recorded
assets.body: Release 2 is now current. One accepted artifact depends on the corrected fact and needs your decision. Nothing was edited or published automatically.

assets.author: Product systems writer
assets.truth_dependency: versioned identity release and immutable binding
assets.effect_boundary: Standalone draft; it contains all context but is not published.
assets.headline: A brand guide cannot tell you which old claim became wrong
assets.body: Most identity systems stop at advice: use these colours, prefer these words, act according to these values. The hard problem starts after the advice changes. A useful system must remember which exact artifact relied on which exact fact—and leave the decision to change that artifact with its owner.

assets.author: Founder
assets.effect_boundary: Preview only; posting requires outreach authority.
assets.headline: Your company changed. Your history did not.
assets.body: Restless can now show which accepted artifacts depend on a corrected company fact—then ask whether to keep, revise or retire each one.

assets.author: Operating lead
assets.effect_boundary: Decision guidance only; Work and effect controls remain authoritative.
assets.headline: Use identity evidence; do not turn it into permission
assets.body: The constitution can block a contradictory claim and show a relevant way of working. It cannot send, deploy, pay, contact a customer or overrule an accountable owner. When a pillar is unavailable, name the gap instead of inventing a default.

company_b.name: Harbour Ledger

identity.truth: Gives marine crews an offline maintenance record.
identity.voice: Calm, terse and specific, like a practical vessel log.
identity.visual: Spacious paper-like records, marine blue ink, no ornamental motion.
identity.culture: Stop and document uncertainty before safety-critical maintenance decisions.
